onboarding_1_desc: Clock in/out in seconds by scanning location-secured QR codes with automatic shift and geofence verification.
onboarding_2_desc: Record field visits, client meetings, and daily task progress with GPS coordinates and instant photo attachments.
onboarding_3_desc: Apply for annual, sick, or special leaves effortlessly, check remaining balances, and track approval workflows in real time.
onboarding_4_desc: Complete corporate training quizzes, compliance tests, and track your scores with instant feedback and certifications.
onboarding_5_desc: Monitor your professional growth with supervisor notes, good/bad progress entries, and recognized merit achievements.
onboarding_6_desc: Access your assigned work shifts, company holiday schedules, and team roster in one unified calendar view.
onboarding_7_desc: Stay updated with critical company announcements, real-time push alerts, team birthday celebrations, and wishes.
